videos.title: Why do we need AI Agents when we have AI models?
videos.description:
The model never touches your computer. The agent does.

A model reads text and writes text, and that's the full extent of it. Ask it to fix your code and it can describe the fix perfectly, but it can't open the file, apply the change, or run the test. Left alone, it's pure reasoning with no way to reach the outside world.

An agent is the software that reaches out for it. It gives the model a menu of tools, and when the model says run this command or edit that file, the agent actually does it, captures the result, and passes it back for the next decision. Claude Opus writes what needs to happe…
